summary: --- title: Per-Route beforeEnter Guards Ignore Param/Query Changes impact: MEDIUM impactDescription: Route-level beforeEnter guards don't fire when only params, query, or hash change, causing unexpected bypasses of validation logic type: gotcha tags: [vue3, vue-router, navigation-guards, params, query] --- # Per-Route beforeEnter Guards Ignore Param/Query Changes **Impact: MEDIUM** - The `beforeEnter` guard defined in route configuration only triggers when entering a route from a DIFFERENT route. Changes to params, query strings, or hash within the same route do NOT trigger `beforeEnter`, potentially bypassing important validation logic. ## Task Checklist
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
